title: Forms React Parity
description: Restore the forms experience in the React renderer to the level it had at git tag premigration. Replace the Blueprint table with the rich card-based builder emitted declaratively from the forms plugin, bring the Try wizard to premigration fidelity (step titles, field descriptions, required markers, inline validation errors, disabled navigation until valid, slider units, number min/max/step, file accept, URL image rendering, chip-row multi select), fix catalogue drag-and-drop end-to-end in the React renderer (MIME wiring plus a real drop dispatch of dropQuestionKind), make inspector kind-specific fields always editable, and extend the shared UiNode schema (field description/required/error, slider unit, input min/max/step/accept, button disabled, tree drop command, selectable-card stacks, image node) with TS mirrors and React interpreter support.
summary: Restored forms to premigration level for the React renderer. Extended the shared UiNode schema (UiFieldNode description/required/error + child widened to Box<UiNode>, UiSliderNode unit, UiInputNode min/max/step/accept, UiButtonNode disabled, UiTreeNode dropCommand, UiStackNode id/selected/activate/dropCommand selectable-card + drop-target capability, new UiImageNode) with TS mirrors and React interpreter support (ui-react Field with inline errors, slider unit readout, disabled buttons, selectable cards with ring highlight, image nodes, id-based child keys fixing a controlled-input warning, MIME-aware tree drag controller with real dropCommand dispatch). Forms plugin: Try wizard now shows step titles, descriptions, required markers, per-field inline validation errors, chip-row multi select, check-icon booleans, chevron nav with Back disabled at step 1 and Next/Submit gated by can_advance, URL/data-URI images via the new image node (replacing the broken RasterScene decode path); Blueprint table replaced with the rich card-based builder (form title editor, step title/description editors, selectable per-question cards with kind badges, label/required editors, shared always-editable kind-specific editor fields reused by the inspector, add/remove/move step and question actions, per-step drop zones); added patchStep/removeStep/moveStep/updateForm commands and the FormOp::UpdateForm VCS op; catalogue drag-and-drop now works end-to-end in React (verified live: drop inserted and selected a new question). Mechanical fallout: ~350 struct-literal updates across all plugin crates via ticket-folder codemods; stale raster/blueprint tests fixed. Verified: cargo test forms(5)/forms-plugin(25) green, react vitest 64 green, wasm rebuilt, live browser session on port 6558 confirmed wizard gating, inline errors, builder editing with try-window sync, selection round-trip, undo, and DnD. exportFixture stays a no-op (premigration was itself only a debug log; no plugin log channel exists); wgpu support for the new schema fields is fallback-level (separate wgpu parity ticket).
